title: AGI Capability Map
subtitle: Research dimensions, safety gates and evaluation signals
disclaimer: This map does not claim that AGI has been achieved. It separates capabilities, measurements and governance requirements to avoid turning marketing claims into facts.

nodes.label: AGI research target
nodes.description: A research target rather than a verified status label. This map does not assert that any listed system has achieved AGI.

nodes.label: Perception
nodes.description: Robust interpretation of multimodal sensory input across changing environments.

nodes.label: Language
nodes.description: Understanding and generating language across domains and contexts.

nodes.label: Reasoning
nodes.description: Generalizable inference across logic, mathematics, science and unfamiliar problems.

nodes.label: Planning
nodes.description: Forming and revising multi-step plans under constraints and uncertainty.

nodes.label: Long-horizon agency
nodes.description: Sustained task execution over long horizons with monitoring and recovery.

nodes.label: Tool / computer use
nodes.description: Safe use of software, APIs and external tools to achieve goals.

nodes.label: Persistent memory
nodes.description: Retention and retrieval of useful task/user/world state across time.

nodes.label: World models
nodes.description: Internal models that support prediction, simulation and causal planning.

nodes.label: Embodied intelligence
nodes.description: Perception-action loops in physical environments and robotics.

nodes.label: Continual learning
nodes.description: Adapting to new information or environments without destructive forgetting.

nodes.label: Social intelligence
nodes.description: Interpreting intent, norms and human interaction while respecting policy boundaries.

nodes.label: Uncertainty calibration
nodes.description: Knowing when evidence is weak and expressing uncertainty rather than fabricating certainty.

nodes.label: Alignment / control
nodes.description: Keeping model behavior within intended goals, policies and operator authorization.

nodes.label: Evaluations
nodes.description: Capability, robustness and safety evaluations that test claims under controlled conditions.

nodes.label: Security boundaries
nodes.description: Permissioning, sandboxing, provenance and effect verification around agent actions.

nodes.label: Economic usefulness
nodes.description: Performance on economically meaningful tasks without equating usefulness with AGI.

nodes.label: Scientific discovery
nodes.description: Ability to assist with hypothesis generation, analysis and validated scientific work.
